title: Ferritinophagy-related prognostic genes UBE2Q1, NEDD4L, and TCP11L2 for prognosis prediction in sepsis.

models.outcome_definition: overall survival in GSE65682 (28-day follow-up; time ROC at 9, 18, 27 days)
models.expression_scale_used: unclear (GSE65682 GPL13667 expression as downloaded; no transformation stated)
models.cutoff: median risk score in training set
models.reported_performance: GSE65682 training (70% of 479): KM p=0.012; time AUC 0.65 (9 d), 0.64 (18 d), 0.63 (27 d). GSE65682 validation (30%): 'similar' (Fig. S2, values not in text).
models.source_location: Methods 'Construction of risk model' + Results paragraph with formula (Table S9) + Fig. 3
models.released_code_or_model: https://pan.baidu.com/s/1aCBDCFEjVMZda-JM0l9ukA (extraction code 1234; R script and supplementary materials, not checked)

notes: 479 GSE65682 patients with survival split 7:3 (exact n per split not stated). Candidate genes from DEG (GSE65682 sepsis vs control) + WGCNA on ferritinophagy ssGSEA score + Mendelian randomization (eQTL / ieu-b-4980 GWAS) -> univariate Cox (p<0.01, PH test) -> LASSO kept all 3 genes; coefficients are LASSO coefs (lambda.min=0.01648664). A nomogram on the 3 genes was also built but its stated target ('risk of sepsis') and coefficients are unclear; not recorded separately. Data-availability statement names GSE154918 and GSE134347, which are not otherwise mentioned in methods/results (possibly a boilerplate error) - listed as 'other' to be conservative. Methods text typo 'GSE165682' = GSE65682.
